substitutionTest.rule: Standing surviving-sentence count, run for every section on coordinator instruction before any pairing test
substitutionTest.note: Standing procedure, run before any pairing test: 7 of 16 testable baseline sentences of four or more words survive verbatim in the current text after punctuation normalization. The count is nonzero, so the section is not in substitution mode and the pairing tests apply. The shortfall is dominated by the recorded coda-scaffold removal, the linked reading-path lines, and ledger-bounded sentences whose interiors changed by one modality word.

ledgerSearch.outcome: CTD-0036 is a high-severity query over the population threshold and the semantic review records that the pass converted roughly 150 from a natural relational limit into a provisional design scale requiring evidence and nesting. That binds. CTD-0076 requires Scale as the singular and ICONS only as the plural; the baseline uses the acronym for the communities themselves, which the item forbids, so the pass's correction is kept.

findings.summary: The section was replaced, not condensed.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, recorded in editorial/evidence/reviews/volumes/volume-06/2026-07-09-production-pass/compression.md as a 39.8 percent reduction.

findings.summary: The chamber's coda scaffold is not restored.

evidence.baseline: You want to matter, and you want to be known, and the world keeps making you choose between them.

findings.authorizedBy: The voice card's known weak passages, and the semantic review's record of the coda removal.
findings.diagnosis: Coda scaffold not restored. The baseline closes this chamber with a divider, two italic address lines, the isolated line That is why, and a fourth italic line beginning That is why. The Volume VI voice card lists any return of the repeated divider plus That is why coda among its known weak passages, and the semantic review records the pass's removal of the scaffold as a structural repair. The address lines also tell the reader what they have felt, waited for, or were made to become, which is the defect CTD-0091 was opened for and which the corpus card forbids outright. The scaffold is therefore left removed. Where a coda carried content rather than performance, that content is restored into the chamber body. This coda's first line tells the reader what they want, which is the corpus card's flat prohibition.

findings.summary: The description of what the scale makes possible lost all three of its clauses.

evidence.baseline: where you can still be known by name, still be missed when you are gone, still be held to your word by people who will see you again tomorrow.
evidence.shipped: small enough that people remain mutually legible.

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.4, synthetic symmetry, and the recorded correction to the population claim.
findings.diagnosis: The ledger correction concerns the number, not the description. Held to your word by people who will see you again tomorrow is the chamber's account of how accountability works at scale, and mutually legible is a term of art that names none of it.

findings.summary: The chamber's argument that the right size can still hold the wrong people was cut to a sentence about constraint.

evidence.baseline: But the right size can still hold the wrong people, and this is where every previous age fell short. There has never been a coordinating device able to compose these groups well, to gather, from across the whole of humanity, the particular cohort in which a given person would actually come alive, and to let people move between cohorts as they change and grow.
evidence.shipped: Size alone cannot compose a healthy community. Historically, belonging has often been constrained by birth, necessity, exclusion, and geography.

findings.diagnosis: The cohort in which a person would actually come alive is the chamber's reason for wanting a coordinating device at all, and the freedom to move between cohorts is the safeguard the baseline builds in. Both are the argument, not its ornament.

debtImpact.note: Roughly a hundred and fifty is restored as prose and immediately bounded: a provisional design scale rather than a proven natural law, with nested groups and explicit means of keeping trust and accountability required at larger sizes. The closing sentence states that what the scale exactly is remains open to evidence and practice.
The baseline applies Individual Communities Observing Natural Sovereignty to the communities themselves. The corrected form is kept: each single community is a Scale, and the plural network is ICONS.
The pass's protections for refusal, movement, difference, and the right not to be classified are kept.

R-LEDGER-WINS across two items, both bounded in place inside restored paragraphs.
For the first time, which the card lists among phrases to reduce and which the sentence does not need.

The two ways a weave fails, the three things possible at the scale, the right size holding the wrong people, the cohort where a person would come alive, movement between cohorts, belonging left to accident, and the smallest whole things from which a larger whole is made.

generations.label: A1
generations.title: Audited 2026-07-31 against the immutable baseline under the twenty-rule standard

reasoning.note: R-CAUTIOUS-HALF. Build at that scale, and the abstractions become daily life survives committing; the provisional-design-scale bound follows in its own sentence at the width CTD-0036 names.

R-CORRECTION-SCOPE. Three corrections checked at width: the population bound, the Scale and ICONS separation under CTD-0076, and the destiny phrase where we are meant to rendered as where we might best belong. Each stops at its named span, and the existing open question about the last stands.

R-REFRAIN-COST. The divider plus That is why coda is a volume-wide refrain, removed once by one decision. The anchor record v06-the-current carries the refrain finding with its count of eleven; this chamber cites the anchor rather than repeating the analysis.

R-PAIRED-DELETION. Term sweep run over the section's distinctive named terms against the baseline and the current corpus. No cross-reference was restored at one end; no dependency blocks. Scale and ICONS pair with Volume V's naming and The Return to the Human's summary; all ends use the singular and plural as the item requires.

R-DEIXIS and R-TENSE checked against the baseline's demonstratives and verb forms. Nothing fires. R-CANON-DELETION-RECORD. No claim named in an open canon query was cut from this section by this audit or left unrecorded by generation A.
Nothing further fires. The prose stands as generation A left it.

openQuestions: Where we are meant to is rendered as where we might best belong. The baseline's phrasing assigns a destined place, which the card forbids, and the correction slightly weakens the sentence's contrast with where we need to.

Voice card exemplar anchors. The Volume VI card lists opening anchors drawn from the compressed pass rather than from the baseline, so a faithful re-render displaces some of them. Four of the card's five protected lines were also authored by the pass and do not exist in the baseline at all; all four are kept verbatim. The card needs re-preparation against the re-rendered source, and that is a card revision the author should authorise.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the shipped text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the corpus card, the volume-06 voice card, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. The chamber is the clearest case in the volume of a correction that governs a number and was applied to a paragraph. CTD-0036 concerns what a hundred and fifty means; it says nothing about being known by name or held to your word, and those went with it.
